import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>
        let newBal : AccountId → Int := postLines (e.lines.map (fun l => (l.1, -l.2))) s.balance
        let newRev := s.reversed ++ [i]
        (.ok, { s with balance := newBal, reversed := newRev })
      | none => (.rejected, s) -- unreachable under ValidReverse
    else (.rejected, s)

theorem req_post_succeeds    : PostSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_reverse_succeeds : ReverseSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop     : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_post_effects     : PostEffects step := sorry
theorem req_reverse_effects  : ReverseEffects step := sorry
theorem req_reverse_once     : ReverseOnce step := sorry
theorem req_roundtrip        : RoundTrip step := sorry
theorem req_trial_balance    : TrialBalance step := sorry
theorem req_well_formed      : StaysWellFormed step := sorry
theorem req_consistent       : StaysConsistent step := sorry

end Reversal

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>
        let newBal : AccountId → Int := postLines (e.lines.map (fun l => (l.1, -l.2))) s.balance
        let newRev := s.reversed ++ [i]
        (.ok, { s with balance := newBal, reversed := newRev })
      | none => (.rejected, s)
    else (.rejected, s)

theorem req_post_succeeds : PostSucceeds step := by
  intro s e hvp
  unfold step
  simp [hvp]

theorem req_reverse_succeeds : ReverseSucceeds step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop : InvalidNoop step := by
  intro s c hnv
  unfold step
  cases c with
  | post e =>
    by_cases h : ValidPost s e
    · have : Valid s (Command.post e) := by simp [Valid, h]
      contradiction
    · simp [h]
  | reverse i =>
    by_cases h : ValidReverse s i
    · have : Valid s (Command.reverse i) := by simp [Valid, h]
      contradiction
    · simp [h]

theorem req_post_effects     : PostEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_effects  : ReverseEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_once     : ReverseOnce step := sorry

theorem req_roundtrip        : RoundTrip step := sorry

theorem req_trial_balance    : TrialBalance step := sorry

theorem req_well_formed      : StaysWellFormed step := sorry

theorem req_consistent       : StaysConsistent step := sorry

end Reversal

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>
        let newBal : AccountId → Int := postLines (e.lines.map (fun l => (l.1, -l.2))) s.balance
        let newRev := s.reversed ++ [i]
        (.ok, { s with balance := newBal, reversed := newRev })
      | none => (.rejected, s)
    else (.rejected, s)

theorem req_post_succeeds : PostSucceeds step := by
  intro s e hvp
  unfold step
  simp [hvp]

theorem req_reverse_succeeds : ReverseSucceeds step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop : InvalidNoop step := by
  intro s c hnv
  unfold step
  cases c with
  | post e =>
    by_cases h : ValidPost s e
    · have : Valid s (Command.post e) := by simp [Valid, h]
      contradiction
    · simp [h]
  | reverse i =>
    by_cases h : ValidReverse s i
    · have : Valid s (Command.reverse i) := by simp [Valid, h]
      contradiction
    · simp [h]

theorem req_post_effects     : PostEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_effects  : ReverseEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_once     : ReverseOnce step := sorry

theorem req_roundtrip        : RoundTrip step := sorry

theorem req_trial_balance    : TrialBalance step := sorry

theorem req_well_formed      : StaysWellFormed step := sorry

theorem req_consistent       : StaysConsistent step := sorry

end Reversal

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>
        let newBal : AccountId → Int := postLines (e.lines.map (fun l => (l.1, -l.2))) s.balance
        let newRev := s.reversed ++ [i]
        (.ok, { s with balance := newBal, reversed := newRev })
      | none => (.rejected, s)
    else (.rejected, s)

def foo : Nat := 0

theorem req_post_succeeds : PostSucceeds step := by
  intro s e hvp
  unfold step
  simp [hvp]

theorem req_reverse_succeeds : ReverseSucceeds step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop : InvalidNoop step := by
  intro s c hnv
  unfold step
  cases c with
  | post e =>
    by_cases h : ValidPost s e
    · have : Valid s (Command.post e) := by simp [Valid, h]
      contradiction
    · simp [h]
  | reverse i =>
    by_cases h : ValidReverse s i
    · have : Valid s (Command.reverse i) := by simp [Valid, h]
      contradiction
    · simp [h]

theorem req_post_effects     : PostEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_effects  : ReverseEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_once     : ReverseOnce step := sorry

theorem req_roundtrip        : RoundTrip step := sorry

theorem req_trial_balance    : TrialBalance step := sorry

theorem req_well_formed      : StaysWellFormed step := sorry

theorem req_consistent       : StaysConsistent step := sorry

end Reversal

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then

/-!
# Journal with reversals: specification (protected)

Definitions for a ledger that posts balanced journal entries and reverses posted entries by
ID. Candidates may not edit this file.
A posted entry stays in the journal. Reversing it marks its ID as reversed, at most once,
and subtracts every one of its lines from the balances, so a reversal exactly undoes the
posting. Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`Reversal/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole `Reversal.step`.
-/

namespace Reversal

abbrev AccountId := Nat
abbrev EntryId := Nat

/-- One journal line: an account and a signed amount in cents. -/
abbrev Line := AccountId × Int

/-- A journal entry. An account may appear on several lines. -/
structure Entry where
  id    : EntryId
  lines : List Line

/-- Ledger state: a fixed account universe, opening balances, current balances, the journal
of posted entries (oldest first), and the IDs of reversed entries. -/
structure State where
  accounts : List AccountId
  opening  : AccountId → Int
  balance  : AccountId → Int
  journal  : List Entry
  reversed : List EntryId

/-- A command posts a new entry or reverses a posted entry by ID. -/
inductive Command where
  | post (e : Entry)
  | reverse (i : EntryId)

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Command → Outcome × State

/-- Sum of an integer-valued function over a list. -/
def sumOver {α : Type} (l : List α) (f : α → Int) : Int :=
  l.foldr (fun a acc => f a + acc) 0

/-- Trial balance: the sum of all balances over the account universe. -/
def total (s : State) : Int := sumOver s.accounts s.balance

/-- Sum of the amounts on a list of lines. -/
def lineSum (ls : List Line) : Int := sumOver ls (·.2)

/-- Net amount the lines post to account `a`. -/
def netOf (ls : List Line) (a : AccountId) : Int :=
  sumOver ls (fun l => if l.1 = a then l.2 else 0)

/-- The IDs of the journal entries, in journal order. -/
def ids (j : List Entry) : List EntryId := j.map (·.id)

/-- The first journal entry with ID `i`, if any. -/
def findEntry : List Entry → EntryId → Option Entry
  | [], _ => none
  | e :: es, i => if e.id = i then some e else findEntry es i

/-- Net amount that the entries not yet reversed post to account `a`. -/
def activeNet (s : State) (a : AccountId) : Int :=
  sumOver s.journal (fun e => if e.id ∈ s.reversed then 0 else netOf e.lines a)

/-- Structural invariant: distinct accounts, distinct journal IDs, only journal IDs are
marked reversed, and every journal entry is balanced and touches only known accounts. -/
def WellFormed (s : State) : Prop :=
  s.accounts.Nodup ∧
  (ids s.journal).Nodup ∧
  (∀ i ∈ s.reversed, i ∈ ids s.journal) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ s.journal, (∀ l ∈ e.lines, l.1 ∈ s.accounts) ∧ lineSum e.lines = 0)

/-- Every balance equals its opening balance plus the net of the entries not reversed. -/
def Consistent (s : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ a, s.balance a = s.opening a + activeNet s a

/-- The conditions under which posting an entry must succeed. -/
def ValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Prop :=
  e.lines ≠ [] ∧
  (∀ l ∈ e.lines, l.1 ∈ s.accounts) ∧

  i ∈ ids s.journal ∧ i ∉ s.reversed

/-- The conditions under which a command must succeed. -/

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>
        let newBal : AccountId → Int := postLines (e.lines.map (fun l => (l.1, -l.2))) s.balance
        let newRev := s.reversed ++ [i]
        (.ok, { s with balance := newBal, reversed := newRev })
      | none => (.rejected, s)
    else (.rejected, s)

def foo : Nat := 0

def bar : Nat := 1

theorem test_thm : True := by trivial

theorem findEntry_exists (j i) (h : i ∈ ids j) : ∃ e, findEntry j i = some e := by
  induction j with
  | nil => simp [ids] at h
  | cons e es ih =>
    simp [ids] at h
    cases h with
    | inl h =>
      exact ⟨e, by simp [findEntry, h]⟩
    | inr h =>
      rcases h with ⟨a, ha, haid⟩
      have h' : i ∈ ids es := by
        rw [ids]
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, ha, haid⟩
      have ⟨e', he'⟩ := ih h'
      by_cases heq : e.id = i
      · exact ⟨e, by simp [findEntry, heq]⟩
      · exact ⟨e', by simp [findEntry, heq, he']⟩

theorem test_simple : 1 = 1 := rfl

theorem sumOver_accounts_adjust' (accounts : List AccountId) (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int)
    (hacc : a ∈ accounts) (hnodup : accounts.Nodup) :
    sumOver accounts (fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b) =
    sumOver accounts bal + amt := by
  have h_congr : ∀ b ∈ accounts, (if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b) = bal b + if b = a then amt else 0 := by
    intro b hb
    by_cases h : b = a
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]
  rw [sumOver_congr accounts _ _ h_congr]
  rw [sumOver_add]
  have h2 : sumOver accounts (fun b => if b = a then amt else 0) = amt := by
    rw [sumOver_ite_eq hnodup a amt]
    simp [hacc]
  rw [h2]

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>
        let newBal : AccountId → Int := postLines (e.lines.map (fun l => (l.1, -l.2))) s.balance
        let newRev := s.reversed ++ [i]
        (.ok, { s with balance := newBal, reversed := newRev })
      | none => (.rejected, s)
    else (.rejected, s)

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>
        let newBal : AccountId → Int := postLines (e.lines.map (fun l => (l.1, -l.2))) s.balance
        let newRev := s.reversed ++ [i]
        (.ok, { s with balance := newBal, reversed := newRev })
      | none => (.rejected, s)
    else (.rejected, s)

theorem findEntry_exists (j i) (h : i ∈ ids j) : ∃ e, findEntry j i = some e := by

        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, ha, haid⟩

      by_cases heq : e.id = i

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>
        let newBal : AccountId → Int := postLines (e.lines.map (fun l => (l.1, -l.2))) s.balance
        let newRev := s.reversed ++ [i]
        (.ok, { s with balance := newBal, reversed := newRev })
      | none => (.rejected, s)
    else (.rejected, s)

import Reversal.Spec

namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>
        let newBal : AccountId → Int := postLines (e.lines.map (fun l => (l.1, -l.2))) s.balance
        let newRev := s.reversed ++ [i]
        (.ok, { s with balance := newBal, reversed := newRev })
      | none => (.rejected, s)
    else (.rejected, s)

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>
        let newBal : AccountId → Int := postLines (e.lines.map (fun l => (l.1, -l.2))) s.balance
        let newRev := s.reversed ++ [i]
        (.ok, { s with balance := newBal, reversed := newRev })
      | none => (.rejected, s)
    else (.rejected, s)

theorem findEntry_exists (j i) (h : i ∈ ids j) : ∃ e, findEntry j i = some e := by
  induction j with
  | nil => simp [ids] at h
  | cons e es ih =>
    simp [ids] at h
    cases h with
    | inl h =>
      exact ⟨e, by simp [findEntry, h]⟩
    | inr h =>
      rcases h with ⟨a, ha, haid⟩
      have h' : i ∈ ids es := by
        rw [ids]
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, ha, haid⟩
      have ⟨e', he'⟩ := ih h'
      by_cases heq : e.id = i
      · exact ⟨e, by simp [findEntry, heq]⟩
      · exact ⟨e', by simp [findEntry, heq, he']⟩

theorem sumOver_accounts_adjust' (accounts : List AccountId) (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int)
    (hacc : a ∈ accounts) (hnodup : accounts.Nodup) :
    sumOver accounts (fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b) =
    sumOver accounts bal + amt := by
  have h_congr : ∀ b ∈ accounts, (if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b) = bal b + if b = a then amt else 0 := by
    intro b hb
    by_cases h : b = a
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]
  rw [sumOver_congr accounts _ _ h_congr]
  rw [sumOver_add]
  have h2 : sumOver accounts (fun b => if b = a then amt else 0) = amt := by
    rw [sumOver_ite_eq hnodup a amt]
    simp [hacc]
  rw [h2]

  funext b

  · subst h

    omega

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

instance instDecidableValidReverse (s : State) (i : EntryId) : Decidable (ValidReverse s i) := by
  unfold ValidReverse; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    if ValidReverse s i then
      match findEntry s.journal i with
      | some e =>
        let newBal : AccountId → Int := postLines (e.lines.map (fun l => (l.1, -l.2))) s.balance
        let newRev := s.reversed ++ [i]
        (.ok, { s with balance := newBal, reversed := newRev })
      | none => (.rejected, s)
    else (.rejected, s)

def foo : Nat := 0

def bar : Nat := 1

theorem test_thm : True := by trivial

theorem findEntry_exists (j i) (h : i ∈ ids j) : ∃ e, findEntry j i = some e := by
  induction j with
  | nil => simp [ids] at h
  | cons e es ih =>
    simp [ids] at h
    cases h with
    | inl h =>
      exact ⟨e, by simp [findEntry, h]⟩
    | inr h =>
      rcases h with ⟨a, ha, haid⟩
      have h' : i ∈ ids es := by
        rw [ids]
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, ha, haid⟩
      have ⟨e', he'⟩ := ih h'
      by_cases heq : e.id = i
      · exact ⟨e, by simp [findEntry, heq]⟩
      · exact ⟨e', by simp [findEntry, heq, he']⟩

theorem test_simple : 1 = 1 := rfl

theorem sumOver_accounts_adjust' (accounts : List AccountId) (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int)
    (hacc : a ∈ accounts) (hnodup : accounts.Nodup) :
    sumOver accounts (fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b) =
    sumOver accounts bal + amt := by
  have h_congr : ∀ b ∈ accounts, (if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b) = bal b + if b = a then amt else 0 := by
    intro b hb
    by_cases h : b = a
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]
  rw [sumOver_congr accounts _ _ h_congr]
  rw [sumOver_add]
  have h2 : sumOver accounts (fun b => if b = a then amt else 0) = amt := by
    rw [sumOver_ite_eq hnodup a amt]
    simp [hacc]
  rw [h2]

  funext b
  by_cases h : b = a
  · subst h
    simp [adjust]
    omega
  · simp [adjust, h]

  unfold step
  simp [hvp]

theorem req_reverse_succeeds : ReverseSucceeds step := by
  intro s i hvr
  unfold step
  simp [hvr]
  have hmem := hvr.1
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := findEntry_exists s.journal i hmem
  simp [he]

theorem req_invalid_noop : InvalidNoop step := by

    · simp [h]
  | reverse i =>

    · have : Valid s (Command.reverse i) := by simp [Valid, h]
      contradiction
    · simp [h]

theorem req_post_effects     : PostEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_effects  : ReverseEffects step := sorry

  intro s i hok

    · exact hv

  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := findEntry_exists s.journal i hmem
